newsitem.title: USA: Sano says patch lessens anxiety in trial.
newsitem.headline: Sano says patch lessens anxiety in trial.

text.p: Sano Corp said its buspirone transdermal patch cut baseline anxiety levels, based on a preliminary analysis of the first efficacy trials in its Phase III clinical program.
The patch cut anxiety "within the range of the reduction achieved by clinically effective anxiolytics in other trials," the company said in a statement.
However, Sano stressed that results of this first trial were not statistically significant. The study was conducted in 170 patients, at two centers, divided into two groups, active and placebo.
